messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — High rate of tool/function-call parser errors for tenant 'harbor-prod' in dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-east-2-1' (VPC). Aggregated json parse failures on `tool.call` endpoint. Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood/incident/1795129876

Tariq: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now.

kim: I see the page — last night we rolled parser v3.2. Could be related.

sahil: quick log snippet:
```
ERROR jsonschema.ValidationError: 'payload_input' is a required property
incoming: {"input_payload":"..."}
expected schema: {"payload_input": "<string>", ...}
```

sahil: tl;dr — customer adapter is still sending `input_payload` but new parser expects `payload_input`. schema drift.

jess: Harbor told SEs they upgraded their adapter last week but maybe to an intermediate version. CH-7832 shows adapter v2.1 on prod.

Tariq: impact?

kim: ~12% of toolcall responses failing for harbor-prod in last 15m, errors are parse failures (4xx). Latency not degraded but retries are up which bloats cost and surfaces errors to the customer.

Tariq: immediate mitigation options — list so we pick one quickly:
- revert parser rollout (hotfix rollback)
- enable `compat_input_aliases` feature flag to accept both `input_payload` and `payload_input`
- route harbor traffic to fallback parser runtime (old stable) in the dedicated pool
- apply throttling to reduce retry storms

robin: taking over (oncall handoff) — I'm finishing another page but will pick this up. Brief me?

Tariq: done initial triage. root cause: parser schema update; harbor adapter lagging. recommended immediate action: enable compat flag + route small % to fallback runtime until adapter is updated.

deploy-bot: @tariq triggered config change: enabling `compat_input_aliases` for pool `dedicated-us-east-2-1` (change id c4f2a9). Starting rollout to 3/6 hosts.

deploy-bot: rollout 50% complete on hosts. no host errors reported.

kim: opened CH-7832 to Harbor and CC'd their platform SEs. asked them to confirm adapter version and ETA for patch.

sahil: monitoring: error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% after flag enabled. graphs: https://redwood/monitoring/graphs/harbor-parser (short link).

robin: initiating traffic pin: routing 10% of harbor-prod to fallback parser to soak test. command:
```
routed(tenant=harbor-prod, target=fallback-parser, weight=10%)
```

opsbot: routing change applied (txn id r-91f3).

jess: notified Harbor (CH-7832) with mitigation notes and asked for adapter patch plan. customer acked receipt and said they'll prioritize.

robin: handover note: I'll keep paging open for 2h, will escalate if error rate spikes above 2%. tagging @oncall-next for overnight follow-up.

oncall-next: ack. will monitor dashboards and alert if regression.

incident-bot: UPDATE — monitoring shows stable at ~0.7% errored toolcalls for 30m. continuing to watch.

Tariq: recommendation for postmortem items: add gating test to validate adapter-schema compatibility before parser rollouts; improve rollout canary to include non-hosted tenant adapters.

neha: follow-up idea: add synthetic test that submits both `payload_input` and `input_payload` permutations during preflight. helps catch renames.

robin: noted, adding a ticket and PR reference: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1820 (adding compat unit tests + gating job).

incident-bot: RESOLVED — mitigation in place, monitoring for 60m. incident link: https://redwood/incident/1795129876/resolve

kim: will keep CH open until Harbor patches adapter. closing thread after 60m stable. :white_check_mark:
